title: The Auction Room
bigIdea: Prices move when buyers and sellers disagree.

steps.prompt: A rare trading card goes up for auction. Suddenly a crowd of new buyers shows up. What happens to the price?

options.text: It falls because there is more interest
It stays the same no matter what

steps.reveal: More buyers chasing the same item means they bid against each other, so the price rises. That is demand at work.

cards.title: Supply and demand
cards.body: Demand is how many people want to buy. Supply is how many want to sell. Price is where the two meet.

cards.title: Bid and ask
cards.body: A bid is the highest price a buyer will pay. An ask is the lowest price a seller will accept. A trade happens when they agree.

cards.title: News shifts the crowd
cards.body: Good news can pull in buyers and push the price up. Bad news can send sellers rushing and push it down.

steps.goal: Play headline cards, predict which way the price moves each round, and watch the crowd react. (Simulation.)

headlines.text: Surprise award: the item is rarer than anyone thought.
A near-identical copy turns up, so sellers rush to list.
Quiet day: a few more buyers, a few more sellers.

steps.prompt: The price just jumped. Which explanation fits best?

options.text: More buyers wanted in than sellers wanted out, so bids pushed the price up
The company printed more shares overnight
Prices always go up on their own over time

steps.explanation: When demand outweighs supply, buyers compete and the price rises. Price discovery is just buyers and sellers settling on a number.
